story_title: Case of the Floating Art Box
story_description: Four classmates use a ruler and pencil fulcrum to lift an art box safely.
learning_objectives: Identify the effort, load, and fulcrum in a lever
Compare how fulcrum position changes effort and movement

dialogue.speaker: Maya Rivers
dialogue.text: Our art box needs a no-hands lift!

dialogue.speaker: Leo Martinez
dialogue.text: Could a ruler lift it safely?

dialogue.speaker: Amara Johnson
dialogue.text: This pencil can be our fulcrum.

dialogue.speaker: Noah Chen
dialogue.text: The ruler pivots on the fulcrum.

dialogue.speaker: Maya Rivers
dialogue.text: Farther fulcrum means less pushing, I predict.

dialogue.speaker: Noah Chen
dialogue.text: The effort end moved only a little.

dialogue.speaker: Maya Rivers
dialogue.text: This time, lifting needs less effort!

dialogue.speaker: Leo Martinez
dialogue.text: But my effort end traveled farther.

dialogue.speaker: Noah Chen
dialogue.text: Closer fulcrum gives greater mechanical advantage.

dialogue.speaker: Amara Johnson
dialogue.text: Less effort, farther movement, safer lifting!
